    <img class="profielfoto" src="/assets/img/profielfoto.png" alt="Etienne Thomassen"></p>
    <h1>Etiënne Thomassen</h1>
    <p>I am a forest ecologist and forester at <a href="https://bosgroepen.nl/bosgroep-zuid-nederland/">Bosgroep Zuid Nederland</a> and a PhD candidate at <a href="https://www.wur.nl/en/">Wageningen University</a>. I am interested in the growth and development of forests and how to steer those processes. Currently I am mainly working on the topics of forest climate adaptation and enhancing resilience of forests.</p>
